mandatory_assessment_items.SA01: Bind the assessment to the exact reviewed residual Schema-V2 insufficiency proof and completed human-review chain.
mandatory_assessment_items.SA02: Determine whether the reviewed residual gaps can be resolved without a schema successor while preserving the existing exact V4 losslessness and admissibility constraints; do not assume the answer.
mandatory_assessment_items.SA03: Assess the minimum explicit semantic-carrier scope required for enforcement/normative-strength semantics and the three unresolved representation-policy assertions.
mandatory_assessment_items.SA04: Assess all other V4 rule-field and exit-obligation field-level reconstruction gaps that remain unproven; do not narrow the assessment only to enforcement plus three policy fields.
mandatory_assessment_items.SA05: Assess whether semantic_accounting can remain accounting-only and what additional semantic carriers are required for deterministic forward preservation and exact reverse reconstruction.
mandatory_assessment_items.SA06: Assess backward compatibility and migration requirements for existing frozen zlib/libpcap Schema-V1 specifications and active Schema-V2 governance artifacts.
mandatory_assessment_items.SA07: Define the minimum governance sequence required if a schema successor is necessary, including successor authoring, independent technical review, hash/dispatch activation governance, positive mapping review, and only then curl canonical materialization.
mandatory_assessment_items.SA08: Conclude one of: NO_SUCCESSOR_REQUIRED_WITH_PROVEN_ADMISSIBLE_V2_MAPPING_PATH; SCHEMA_SUCCESSOR_REQUIRED; or FURTHER_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED. The assessment must not itself author or activate a successor.
